charts.title: TOI-1898 b: orbits around TOI-1898
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-1898's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-1898 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Saha 2025 (2025MNRAS.539..928S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname SAHA_2025): P 45.522129 d

charts.title: TOI-1898 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-1898 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (46, 48, 72) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 91987762, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 17-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 17-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
